headline: 4 Bangladeshi youths sold into 'death trap' in Russia, plead to escape battlefield
summary: Lured by promises of good jobs, these young men were trafficked by a syndicate and are now forced into the war, desperately seeking rescue.
details: Four Bangladeshi youths, lured by promises of lucrative jobs abroad, have reportedly been trafficked into Russia's war zone. They are now trapped on the battlefield and have made a desperate plea for rescue.

The youths fell victim to a broker syndicate that allegedly sold them into the conflict. Their families in Bangladesh are appealing to authorities for urgent intervention to bring them back home safely.

headline: Indonesian mother and three children found dead in Gazipur home
summary: An Indonesian woman and her three children, including two teenage daughters and a speech-impaired son, were discovered with bloody injuries at their Sreepur residence. Her Bangladeshi husband was reportedly in Malaysia.
details: An Indonesian woman and her three children were found dead in their two-story home in Sreepur, Gazipur. Relatives discovered their bloody bodies early one morning.
The victims include two teenage daughters and one speech-impaired son. They had been living on the second floor of the house.
The woman's Bangladeshi husband was reportedly in Malaysia at the time of the tragic incident. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the deaths.
